note: Provincial park at the west end of Lake Diefenbaker, at the historic South Saskatchewan River crossing ~50 km north of Swift Current on Hwy 4. Its campgrounds sit in three places on the north shore: Bearpaw and Sagebrush east of the bridge, Riverside and Nighthawk 2 km further east, and Bison Hollow 5 km west. Riverside's shore row looks at the lake through a line of trees. A separate equestrian campground on the south shore has non-electric horse sites with holding pens. --Claude
